title: Kelly Boesch Official Music Video (AI) - Born To Start Again - 4K
description:
I came back to this old prompt as I just love the dreamy feel of it. These beautiful explorers in fantastic clothes and with gorgeous accessories look so at ease in the harsh environments. And the animals add a touch of beauty. I got this look using a #Midjourney style ref code. Animated using #VEO3. 

I wrote the lyrics for the restless hearts. The truth isn't in the rules they gave us, it's in the things we find when we dare to get lost. 

#ai #aiart #aivideo #music #explore 

Lyrics written by me, Kelly Boesch. Music created under my creative direction with assistance from Suno.

#ai #aiart #aivideo #music #dance
